fnol_text: My name is Lucia Santos and I live at 373 Foxglove Court, Madison, WI 53729. You can reach me on (555) 211-5724 or lucia.santos@example.com. During the storm on 13 August 2025 high winds ripped tiles off the roof and rain came into the loft and the back bedroom. Policy HH-2024-00030. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

Site visit to 373 Foxglove Court. Neighbour Declan Al-Sayed was present and confirmed the timeline.
